$comment: The authoritative section registry. One section = one branch = one worktree = one port. Edited by hand when a section is added; read by scripts/ops/worktree.mjs and by the tn-flow skill.

railway.trigger: push to main; Railway builds from GitHub automatically

markets.$comment: Both spellings of the route are here on purpose: `/markets/*` are the real screens and `/market` is the thin hub that still points at them. A section that owned only the plural would leave the singular unowned, which is how `/market` came to be a stub nobody was responsible for.

superchart.$comment: The charting workspace and the engine under it. Registered 2026-08-09 with one job waiting: a pane manager and secondary scales in `lib/superchart/chart-engine/`. Until that exists a chart cannot show a study on its own axis, which is why Voyager's Acceptance E is open — deliberately, and not because Voyager is missing anything. `/marketplace/tools/supercharts` is the catalogue entry and belongs to `tools-data`, not here.

subscriptions.$comment: Released 2026-08-09: Voyager v2 landed with the tier/policy layer its brief depends on, so the hold is lifted. The brief is `Subscriptions_Redesign/design_handoff_subscriptions/Claude_Code_TradingNew_Voyager_Subscriptions.md` — six phases, of which the screen is D; phases B, C and F touch `src/lib/voyager/` and are the `voyager` section's, not this one's. Start with phase A, the read-only audit and migration design. NOTE: `docs/design/subscriptions/` in this repository is SUPERSEDED — it describes five plans (Essential, Plus, Premium, Ultimate, Voyager Private); the lineup is now four (Free, Plus, Pro, Private). The menu entry that points at the screen is shell's; the /marketplace hub page that also links it is still unowned.

start.$comment: "Find my next step" and the guest workspace it feeds. Unowned until 2026-08-09, which is why the plan funnel and its replacement were both built by whoever happened to be nearby. `actions/startPlan.ts` and `lib/start/plan.ts` are still here although the router no longer writes a plan: the account screens read the ones already saved, so removing them is an `account` decision, not this section's.

home.$comment: The public home only. It renders inside the shell and imports SpaceBackdrop from it — that file belongs to `shell`, so a home redesign that needs the backdrop changed asks for it rather than reaching in.

shell.$comment: The frame every page renders inside — header, menus, drawer, footer. It was `shared` until two sections in a row rewrote it non-append-only; ownership is what stops the third from doing it blind. While this branch is open, a section that needs a menu entry asks for it here instead of appending to menu.ts.

explore.$comment: The hub and the asset-class pages under it. `content/assetClasses.ts` is the list the hub is built from and was unowned until 2026-08-09 — the file a change to this section is most likely to need.

shared.$comment: Touched by every section. Append-only protocol — see SKILL.md. A change here is a conflict waiting to happen; keep it to the smallest possible addition at the end of your own block. The header and footer used to be on this list and are now owned by the `shell` section: a menu entry is requested there, not appended here, because the last two header changes were rewrites and would not have resolved by union.

orchestratorOnly.$comment: Never changed inside a section worktree. A change to any of these is requested from the orchestrator, applied once in the integration tree, and picked up by every worktree on the next sync.

lintBaseline.$comment: Pre-existing eslint errors on main as of 2026-08-08. `npm run check` is red because of these. Do not fix them inside a section branch — they belong to whoever owns the file, and a drive-by fix is a merge conflict in somebody else's work.
